v2_failure_diagnosis.basis: candl gaussian_logl can include an add_logdet normalization term; direct covariance allocation represents the bandpower-attributable quadratic form. Small finite-precision/convention bridges are therefore kept explicit rather than assigned to bandpowers.

method.observable_attribution: V2 signed covariance allocation c_i=d_i(C^-1 d)_i retained byte-for-value through JSON input; no rescaling
method.bridge: parent serialized likelihood component chi2 minus raw covariance quadratic chi2
method.bridge_policy: never distribute bridge across TT/TE/EE, spectra, or ell bins
method.dominant_driver_gate: absolute delta bridge / largest absolute observable+ell allocation <= 0.05

forbidden: rescaling signed covariance allocations to force closure
distributing normalization/convention bridge over observables or ell bins
renaming Planck as exact K-039 reproduction
renaming SPT as exact K-040/AxiCLASS reproduction
changing Q011 to a global minimum
